metrics.window_convention: WP-12aq / WP-S2c-8 uses the final local data-year evaluation window, 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, as the first additional H-001 D2 observation after the original full-period no-formal-split baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-001 REP-0002 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this package follows the later repo precedent of explicit non-cloned window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

data_provenance.source_data_notes: OL-0016 derives from REP-0016. REP-0016 used the final local data-year evaluation window, covering 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11. Indicators were warmed up on prior available history, and the backtest window started flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-001 full-period baseline used a no-formal-split retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible.

notes: WP-12ar derives OL-0016 from REP-0016. It covers H-001 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / downstream d2_006_gates evidence production. It does not authorize paired-source reuse, H-005/H-006 work, Path B, EXP scaffold authoring, AUTO successor work, policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper/live, runtime, lifecycle, promotion, demotion, protected-path authority, or downstream authority.
